name: CI (ztd-query-pdo-adapter)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/**'
      - 'packages/ztd-query-mysql/**'
      - 'packages/ztd-query-postgres/**'
      - 'packages/ztd-query-sqlite/**'
      - 'packages/ztd-query-core/**'
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - 'packages/sql-fixture/**'
      - 'packages/phpstan-custom-rules/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ztd-query-pdo-adapter.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter

jobs:
  test-unit:
    name: Unit Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
      - run: composer test:unit

  test-integration:
    name: Integration (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
      - run: composer test:integration

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
      - run: composer lint

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_mysql
          coverage: pcov
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
      - name: infection
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            git fetch origin $GITHUB_BASE_REF
            php -d memory_limit=256M vendor/bin/infection \
              --threads=max \
              --git-diff-lines \
              --git-diff-base=origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF \
              --min-covered-msi=100 \
              --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations \
              --only-covering-test-cases \
              --no-progress \
              --logger-github
          else
            php -d memory_limit=512M vendor/bin/infection \
              --threads=max \
              --min-covered-msi=80 \
              --no-progress \
              --logger-github
          fi
name: CI (sql-faker)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker-fuzz.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/sql-faker

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check
      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat
      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard
      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard
      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

  bench:
    name: Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Run the benchmarks
        run: composer bench

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          tools: infection:0.35.4
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          infection --version
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

defaults:

    working-directory: packages/sql-faker

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check
      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat
      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard
      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard
      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

  bench:
    name: Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Run the benchmarks
        run: composer bench

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          tools: infection:0.35.4
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          infection --version
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

permissions:

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/sql-faker

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check
      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat
      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard
      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard
      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

  bench:
    name: Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Run the benchmarks
        run: composer bench

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          tools: infection:0.35.4
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          infection --version
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

# NOTE: You do not have permission to overwrite this file. Please ask a human operator to perform the changes for you.
#
# Layers describe stages of SQL generation. Subdirectories such as Plan, Token,
# Derivation, Value, Lexeme and Output are implementation details within a stage.
# PHPDoc aliases are assigned to the same stage as their declaring classes.
deptrac:
  paths:
    - ./src
  analyser:
    types:
      - class
      - use
  layers:
    # Compiled syntax definitions and the releases they describe.
    - name: Grammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Grammar/'
    # Reads upstream grammar sources and publishes compiled artifacts.
    - name: Compiler
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Compiler/'
    # Plans, derives, rewrites, realizes and measures generated SQL.
    - name: Generation
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Generation\\Plan\\TRequiresNonEmpty$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Generation\\Coverage\\(Measurement|Trace|Checkpoint|Snapshot|History|Entry|Rewrite)$'
    # Concrete stages depend on the corresponding shared concepts.
    - name: MySqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Grammar/'
    - name: MySqlGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/'
    - name: PostgreSqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Grammar/'
    - name: PostgreSqlGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Generation/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\PostgreSql\\Generation\\Lookahead\\LookaheadRule$'
    - name: SqliteGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Grammar/'
    - name: SqliteGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Generation/'
    # Public entry points, statement aliases and dialect composition.
    - name: Provider
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/[^/]+Provider\.php$'
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Provider/'
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/(MySql|PostgreSql|Sqlite)/StatementType\.php$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\(MySql|PostgreSql|Sqlite)\\StatementType$'
    - name: Faker
      collectors:
        - type: classLike
          value: '^Faker\\.*'
  ruleset:
    Grammar: []
    Compiler: [Grammar]
    Generation: [Grammar, Faker]
    MySqlGrammar: [Grammar]
    MySqlGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, MySqlGrammar, Faker]
    PostgreSqlGrammar: [Grammar]
    PostgreSqlGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, PostgreSqlGrammar, Faker]
    SqliteGrammar: [Grammar]
    SqliteGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, SqliteGrammar, Faker]
    Provider: [Grammar, Generation, MySqlGrammar, MySqlGeneration, PostgreSqlGrammar, PostgreSqlGeneration, SqliteGrammar, SqliteGeneration, Faker]
    Faker: []

name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

# Database Containers

Shared Testcontainers definitions for integration and fuzz tests in this monorepo.
Requires PHP 8.1+, Docker, and the PDO driver for the database being started.
The MySQLi helper also requires `ext-mysqli`.

Add `k-kinzal/container: @dev` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
`{"type": "path", "url": "../container"}` to its Composer repositories.

## Definitions

The profiles preserve the existing images, credentials, database names, wait
strategies, and container lifecycle settings.

| Namespace | Definitions | Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `Container\Fuzz` | `MySql56Container`, `MySql57Container`, `MySql80Container`, `MySql81Container`, `MySql82Container`, `MySql83Container`, `MySql84Container`, `MySql90Container`, `MySql91Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | Pinned MySQL releases and PostgreSQL 17.2; disposable containers for SQL grammar fuzzing |
| `Container\Reusable` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7 and PostgreSQL 16; reused within an adapter fuzzing process |
| `Container\Fixture` | `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.4.7 from Oracle's registry with the `test` database initialized |
| `Container\Pdo` | `MySqlContainer`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0 and PostgreSQL 16; cached PDO connection and isolated database/schema helpers |
| `Container\Mysqli` | `MySqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0; cached MySQLi connection and isolated database helper |

MySQL containers use `root` / `root`. PostgreSQL containers use `test` / `test`,
with `fuzz_test` for fuzzing and `ztd_test` for integration tests.
`Container\PostgreSqlDSN` supplies the shared PostgreSQL wait-strategy DSN.

## Usage

```php
use Container\Fuzz\MySql80Container;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
$host = $instance->getHost();
$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
$grammarVersion = MySql80Container::getGrammarVersion();
```

```php
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Container\Pdo\PostgreSqlContainer;

[$database, $mysql] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
[$schema, $postgres] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
```

Use `Container\Mysqli\MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase()` for a MySQLi connection.
Each helper call selects a fresh database or schema; the connection is reused
within the process. Testcontainers stops the containers at process shutdown.

## Development

```bash
composer install
composer test:unit
composer test:integration
composer lint
```

Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use Container\PostgreSqlDSN;
use LogicException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlDSN::class)]
final class PostgreSqlDSNTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRequiresHostBeforeRendering(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LogicException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Host is required');

        (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withPort(5432)->withDbname('test')->toString();
    }

    public function testRendersHostWithoutOptionalConnectionSettings(): void
    {
        $dsn = (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withHost('127.0.0.1');

        self::assertSame('pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;', $dsn->toString());
        self::assertNull($dsn->getPort());
        self::assertTrue($dsn->requiresHostPort());
    }

    public function testAcceptsMappedEndpointAfterDatabaseIsConfigured(): void
    {
        $dsn = (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withDbname('fuzz_test');
        self::assertNull($dsn->getHost());

        $dsn->withHost('127.0.0.1')->withPort(15432);

        self::assertSame('127.0.0.1', $dsn->getHost());
        self::assertSame(15432, $dsn->getPort());
        self::assertSame('pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=15432;dbname=fuzz_test;', (string) $dsn);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Integration;

use Container\Mysqli\MySqlContainer as MysqliContainer;
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Container\Pdo\PostgreSqlContainer;
use mysqli_result;
use PDOStatement;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(MySqlContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(MysqliContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlContainer::class)]
final class TestDatabaseTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPdoMySqlReusesConnectionWithIsolatedDatabases(): void
    {
        [$firstDatabase, $firstConnection] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $firstConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondDatabase, $secondConnection] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $secondConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstDatabase, $secondDatabase);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT DATABASE()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame($secondDatabase, $result->fetchColumn());
    }

    public function testMysqliReusesConnectionWithIsolatedDatabases(): void
    {
        [$firstDatabase, $firstConnection] = MysqliContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $firstConnection->query('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondDatabase, $secondConnection] = MysqliContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $secondConnection->query('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstDatabase, $secondDatabase);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT DATABASE()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(mysqli_result::class, $result);
        self::assertSame([$secondDatabase], $result->fetch_row());
    }

    public function testPostgreSqlReusesConnectionWithIsolatedSchemas(): void
    {
        [$firstSchema, $firstConnection] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
        $firstConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondSchema, $secondConnection] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
        $secondConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstSchema, $secondSchema);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT current_schema()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame($secondSchema, $result->fetchColumn());
    }
}

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,re
for p in Path('packages/container/src').rglob('*.php'):
 rel=p.relative_to('packages/container/src')
 if rel.parts[0]=='Fuzz': src=Path('packages/sql-faker/fuzz/Container')/p.name
 elif rel.parts[0]=='Reusable': src=Path('packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/fuzz/Container')/p.name
 elif rel.parts[0]=='Fixture': src=Path('packages/sql-fixture/fuzz/Container')/p.name
 elif rel.parts[0]=='Pdo': src=Path('packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/tests/Fixtures')/p.name
 elif rel.parts[0]=='Mysqli': src=Path('packages/ztd-query-mysqli-adapter/tests/Fixtures')/p.name
 else: src=Path('packages/sql-faker/fuzz/Container')/p.name
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+str(src)],text=True)
 after=p.read_text()
 normalize=lambda s: re.sub(r'namespace [^;]+;','namespace Extracted;',s).replace('use Container\\PostgreSqlDSN;\n','')
 assert normalize(before)==normalize(after),(src,p)
print('All 18 extracted definitions match their originals except namespace/import changes.')
PY

# AGENTS

This file is for agents to understand the context of the project.

## Project Goal

Implement a Zero Table Dependencies (ZTD) mechanism for PHP 8.1+ using a PDO Proxy.
The goal is to enable testing without modifying the physical database by using CTEs to shadow tables and simulate writes.

## Core Concepts

- **CTE Shadowing**: Using `WITH` clauses to mock table data for SELECT queries.
- **Result Select Query**: Converting INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries into SELECT queries that return the data that would have been modified.

## Tech Stack

- PHP 8.1+
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
- PHPStan (Level Max)
- PHP-CS-Fixer
- PHPUnit
- Infection
- PHP-Fuzzer

## Coding Rule

- Follow the fix instructions provided in lint error messages

## Packages

### packages/ztd-query-core

Core library for ZTD Query. Provides the foundational interfaces, session management, and query routing logic.
Contains `Session`, query classification interfaces, rewriter contracts, and schema abstractions.
No platform-specific or adapter code — those live in separate packages.

### packages/ztd-query-mysql

MySQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution using phpmyadmin/sql-parser.
Provides `MySqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with MySQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-postgres

PostgreSQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `PgSqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with PostgreSQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-sqlite

SQLite platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `SqliteSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with SQLite support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter

PDO adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdPdo` (extends PDO) and `ZtdPdoStatement` (extends PDOStatement) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

MySQLi adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdMysqli` (extends mysqli) and `ZtdMysqliStatement` (extends mysqli_stmt) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/sql-faker

Faker Provider for generating syntactically valid SQL statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
Based on official grammar definitions, can generate any statement type (DML, DDL, TCL, etc.) and SQL fragments (expressions, clauses, subqueries, CTEs).
Supports MySQL 5.6–9.1, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Used for fuzz testing.

### packages/sql-fixture

Faker Provider for generating test fixture data from SQL schemas.
Parses CREATE TABLE statements and generates type-appropriate fake data using PHP-Faker.
Provides three usage modes: SQL string-based (`FixtureProvider`), PDO connection-based (`DatabaseFixtureProvider`), and DDL file directory-based (`FileFixtureProvider`).
Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Includes object hydration via `ReflectionHydrator`. Used for fuzz testing and integration tests.

### packages/phpstan-custom-rules

Project-specific PHPStan rules package shared across ztd-query packages.
Provides custom rules for code quality and consistency, including forbidden comments (`@phpstan-ignore*`, `//`), restrictions in test classes (no properties/constants/private methods), and source/unit test pairing checks.
Loaded from each package `phpstan.neon` via `vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules/extension.neon`.

## Documents

- [docs/ztd-mechanism.md](docs/ztd-mechanism.md) - Overview and design of the ZTD mechanism
- [docs/mysql-spec.md](docs/mysql-spec.md) - How ZTD handles MySQL SQL statements
- [docs/postgres-spec.md](docs/postgres-spec.md) - How ZTD handles PostgreSQL SQL statements
- [docs/sqlite-spec.md](docs/sqlite-spec.md) - How ZTD handles SQLite SQL statements
- [docs/sql-support-matrix.md](docs/sql-support-matrix.md) - Supported SQL statements and their status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Container;

use Override;
use Testcontainers\Containers\GenericContainer\GenericContainer;
use Testcontainers\Containers\WaitStrategy\PDO\MySQLDSN;
use Testcontainers\Containers\WaitStrategy\PDO\PDOConnectWaitStrategy;

/**
 * The my sql80 container.
 */
final class MySql80Container extends GenericContainer
{
    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $IMAGE = 'mysql:8.0.44';

    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $REUSE_MODE = 'reuse';

    /**
     * @var array<int>|null
     */
    protected static $EXPOSED_PORTS = [3306];

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>|null
     */
    protected static $ENVIRONMENTS = [
        'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD' => 'root',
    ];

    /**
     * @var null|int
     */
    protected static $STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 300;

    #[Override]
    protected function waitStrategy($instance): PDOConnectWaitStrategy
    {
        unset($instance);

        return (new PDOConnectWaitStrategy())
            ->withDsn((new MySQLDSN())->withCharset('utf8mb4'))
            ->withUsername('root')
            ->withPassword('root')
            ->withTimeoutSeconds(120)
            ->withRetryInterval(250000);
    }

    /**
     * Answers grammar version.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public static function getGrammarVersion(): string
    {
        return 'mysql-8.0.44';
    }
}

namespace Fuzz\Container;

use RuntimeException;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

/**
 * Selects a disposable service supplied by CI or starts a local test container.
 */
final class DatabaseEndpoint
{
    /**
     * @return array{string, int}
     * @throws RuntimeException When the service port is invalid or unmapped.
     */
    public static function mysql(): array
    {
        $host = getenv('MYSQL_HOST');
        if ($host !== false) {
            return [$host, self::port('MYSQL_PORT', 3306)];
        }
        $instance = Testcontainers::run(getenv('MYSQL_VERSION') === '8.4.7' ? MySql84Container::class : MySql80Container::class);

        return [str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost()), $instance->getMappedPort(3306) ?? throw new RuntimeException('MySQL port was not mapped.')];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{string, int}
     * @throws RuntimeException When the service port is invalid or unmapped.
     */
    public static function postgres(): array
    {
        $host = getenv('PG_HOST');
        if ($host !== false) {
            return [$host, self::port('PG_PORT', 5432)];
        }
        $instance = Testcontainers::run(PostgreSqlContainer::class);

        return [str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost()), $instance->getMappedPort(5432) ?? throw new RuntimeException('PostgreSQL port was not mapped.')];
    }

    /**
     * @throws RuntimeException When a configured port is not a valid TCP port.
     */
    public static function port(string $variable, int $default): int
    {
        $value = getenv($variable);
        if ($value === false) {
            return $default;
        }
        $port = filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => 65535]]);
        if ($port === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException($variable . ' must be a TCP port between 1 and 65535.');
        }

        return $port;
    }
}

use Testcontainers\Hook\AfterStartHook;

/**
 * Starts the pinned MySQL 8.4 service used by the package tools.
 */
final class MySql84Container extends GenericContainer
{
    use AfterStartHook;

    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $IMAGE = 'mysql:8.4.7';

    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $REUSE_MODE = 'restart';

    /**
     * @var array<int>|null
     */
    protected static $EXPOSED_PORTS = [3306];

    /**
     * @var array<string>|null
     */
    protected static $MOUNTS = ['type=tmpfs,destination=/var/lib/mysql'];

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>|null
     */
    protected static $ENVIRONMENTS = [
        'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD' => 'root',
        'MYSQL_INITDB_SKIP_TZINFO' => '1',
    ];

    /**
     * @var null|int
     */
    protected static $STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 300;

    /**
     * Parallel PHPUnit workers can select the same seeded port candidates.
     *
     * @var null|int
     */
    protected static $STARTUP_CONFLICT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 10;

    /**
     * @var bool|null
     */
    protected static $AUTO_REMOVE_ON_EXIT = true;

    /**
     * Prepare a fresh database and expose its native connection to the caller.
     *
     * @throws RuntimeException If MySQL has no mapped port.
     */
    public function afterStart($instance): void
    {
        $port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306) ?? throw new RuntimeException('MySQL port was not mapped.');
        $host = str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost());
        $connection = new mysqli($host, 'root', 'root', '', $port);
        $connection->query('CREATE DATABASE test CHARACTER SET utf8mb4');
        $connection->select_db('test');
        $connection->set_charset('utf8mb4');
        $instance->setData($connection);
    }

    #[Override]
    protected function waitStrategy($instance): PDOConnectWaitStrategy
    {
        unset($instance);

        return (new PDOConnectWaitStrategy())
            ->withDsn((new MySQLDSN())->withCharset('utf8mb4'))
            ->withUsername('root')
            ->withPassword('root')
            ->withTimeoutSeconds(120)
            ->withRetryInterval(250000);
    }
}

 root=Path('packages',package)
 paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--name-only','--diff-filter=ACMR','--',str(root)],text=True).splitlines()
 paths=[str(Path(p).relative_to(root)) for p in paths if p.endswith('.php') and Path(p).exists()]
